title: AI Git Configuration
description: Configuration schema for AI Git CLI tool

editor.description: Preferred editor command (e.g. 'vim', 'nvim', 'nano'). Overrides $EDITOR environment variable.

provider.description: AI provider to use for generating commit messages.

model.description: Model ID to use for the selected provider.

stageAll.description: Automatically stage all changes (git add -A) before analysis.

commit.description: Automatically commit with the generated message (skip confirmation).

prompt.description: Prompt customization options. These supplement (not replace) the base system prompt.

context.description: Project-specific context to help the AI understand your codebase.
examples: React Native app using Expo SDK 54. Jira tickets: PROJ-123
Monorepo with packages: web, mobile, shared, api
Reference ticket IDs from branch name in footer

examples.description: Custom commit message examples. If provided, these replace the default examples. Each string should be a complete commit message.
examples:
feat(auth): add SSO integration

- implement SAML 2.0 authentication
- add identity provider configuration

fix(api): resolve rate limiting bypass

- add per-user rate limit tracking

slowWarningThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing a slow-generation warning. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 5000.

api.description: API-specific configuration options. Kept for compatibility; options may be ignored by some versions.

modelCacheTTL.description: Preferred model-list cache TTL in hours for API providers (best-effort compatibility setting).

model.description: Claude Code model: '<alias>#<effort>' (e.g., 'haiku#low'). Aliases and effort levels come from models.dev and `claude --help` during `ai-git configure`.
Antigravity CLI model ID (e.g., 'gemini-3.8-flash-low'). Models are fetched dynamically.
Codex model: '<model>#<effort>' (e.g., 'gpt-6.1-terra#low'). Models are fetched dynamically from `codex debug models`.
OpenCode model ID fetched dynamically from `opencode models --verbose`. Variant selections use '<base-model>#<variant>'.
Pi model ID fetched dynamically from Pi's RPC mode. Thinking selections use '<provider/model>#<thinking>'.
OpenRouter model ID (e.g., 'openai/gpt-6.1-terra'). Models are fetched dynamically.
OpenAI model ID (e.g., 'gpt-6.1-terra'). Models are fetched dynamically.
Google AI Studio model ID (e.g., 'gemini-4-hydrogen'). Models are fetched dynamically.
Anthropic API model ID (e.g., 'claude-fable-5-2'). Models are fetched dynamically.
Cerebras model ID (e.g., 'llama-3.3-70b'). Models are fetched dynamically.
